snippet.text: addIncrement (s : State D) (m : Triple D) (p : ScalarField D) (u : Oscillation D) (q : OscillatoryScalar D) (e : ExcludedErrors D) : State D where mean := updated s.mean m; pressure := s.pressure + p; oscillation := s.oscillation + u; oscillatoryPressure := s.oscillatoryPressure + q; errors := s.errors.add e
